regulator_confirmation.source: operator statement in the project conversation
regulator_confirmation.statement: The NUCLEO-F446RE voltage regulator was physically removed before all original STM32 captures. ESP32 and Pico captures are selected from the later series acquired after regulator removal.

time_basis: sample index times 10 microseconds at nominal PPK2 sample rate; no MCU timer timestamps
processing: Original ppk2-api decoder with each capture's saved calibration parameters and original range-switch spike handling; no additional smoothing, decimation, cropping or baseline subtraction.
original_analyses: Copied byte for byte; not recalculated by this export.
